post.summary: Exchange credentials for an access token
post.description:
Token endpoint used by both the Authorization Code grant and the Client
Credentials grant. The client authenticates with HTTP Basic using its
`client_id` and `client_secret` per RFC 6749 §2.3.1.

The `X-Vibe-Revision` header is **not** required on this endpoint.

### Example: client_credentials grant

```bash
curl -sX POST https://api.vibe.co/oauth2/token \
  -u "$CLIENT_ID:$CLIENT_SECRET" \
  --data-urlencode "grant_type=client_credentials" \
  --data-urlencode "scope=account:read account:write advertisers:read advertisers:write audiences:read audiences:write campaigns:read campaigns:write creatives:read creatives:write impression_tracking:read impression_tracking:write reporting:read"
```

The `scope` parameter is optional. If omitted, the token is issued with
all scopes available to the client.

value.scope: account:read account:write advertisers:read advertisers:write audiences:read audiences:write campaigns:read campaigns:write creatives:read creatives:write impression_tracking:read impression_tracking:write reporting:read

details.description: Additional context specific to the failure code

completed_at.description: Time at which the report reached a terminal state

end_date.description: Maximum date (exclusive) for which to return data

asset_url.description: Vibe-hosted URL, populated after processing for VIDEO creatives

total.description: Total number of creatives matching the filters

creative_ids.description: Full list of creatives to attach. Replaces any current attachments.

upload_id.description: Identifier returned by GET /creatives/upload-url after the file has been uploaded.

upload_url.description: S3 endpoint URL — POST a multipart form to this URL with the file and the returned fields.

fields.description: Presigned POST form fields (key, policy, signature, …). Include each entry as a form field of the multipart POST.

upload_id.description: Identifier of the prepared upload. Pass it as `upload_id` when creating the creative.

reach.description: Estimated addressable reach (households for zipcodes, population for other types)

total.description: Total matching locations. In fan-out mode (search without type), this is the sum across all 6 location types.

total.description: Total number of campaigns matching the filters

url.description: The brand-owned website of the advertiser. Marketplace, app store and social media pages are rejected.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the account was created

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the account was last updated

total.description: Total number of advertisers matching the filters

AuthorizationCodeTokenRequest.description: Request body for the `authorization_code` grant at `POST /oauth2/token`.

code.description: Authorization code received on the redirect from `GET /oauth2/auth`.

redirect_uri.description: Must match the `redirect_uri` used when obtaining the authorization code.

ClientCredentialsTokenRequest.description: Request body for the `client_credentials` grant at `POST /oauth2/token`.

scope.description: Optional space-delimited list of requested scopes. If omitted, the token is issued with all scopes available to the client.

TokenResponse.description: Standard OAuth 2.0 token response per RFC 6749 §5.1.

access_token.description: Bearer token to send as `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>` on subsequent API requests.

expires_in.description: Lifetime of the access token in seconds.

scope.description: Space-delimited list of scopes granted to the token. May be a subset of the scopes requested.

refresh_token.description: Present only on `authorization_code` responses. Use at `POST /oauth2/token` with `grant_type=refresh_token` to obtain a new access token.

OAuthError.description:
Standard OAuth 2.0 error envelope per RFC 6749 §5.2. Deliberately distinct
from Vibe's `ErrorResponse` envelope so off-the-shelf OAuth client
libraries parse error responses correctly.

error_uri.description: URI of a page with more information about the error.
